meta.name: prd-generator
meta.description: Generate comprehensive Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) that serve as the single source of truth for engineering, design, QA, and stakeholders. Use when the user needs to create a PRD, feature specification, product requirements, or feature requirements document. Triggers on requests like "create a PRD", "write product requirements", "document this feature", or any request to define a product or feature's purpose, scope, user stories, and success criteria.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品想法整理成含用户故事和成功指标的需求文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是产品经理,常需把想法写成需求文档
copy.tagline_en: Turn product ideas into a requirements document with user stories and success criteria.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a product manager who needs to turn ideas into requirement documents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扮演产品经理,先向你提问收集信息,然后生成一份完整的产品需求文档(PRD),包含目标、范围、用户故事、成功指标等,并保存为 Markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你说“创建 PRD”“写产品需求”“记录这个功能”等,或要求定义产品/功能的目的、范围、用户故事和成功标准时。

say.text: 帮我创建一份 PRD,产品是移动端记账应用。
say.note: Claude 会先问几个问题再生成文档。

say.text: 给购物车功能写一份 Feature Addendum。
say.note: 进入补充模式,生成功能附录。

say.text: 写产品需求文档,包含用户故事和验收标准。
say.note: 直接生成 PRD,跳过提问。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a product manager, first asking you questions to gather information, then generating a complete Product Requirements Document (PRD) covering goals, scope, user stories, success metrics, etc., saved as a Markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "create a PRD", "write product requirements", "document this feature", or any request to define a product/feature's purpose, scope, user stories, and success criteria.

say_en.text: Create a PRD for a mobile expense tracking app.
say_en.note: Claude will ask a few questions first.

say_en.text: Write a Feature Addendum for the shopping cart feature.
say_en.note: Enters addendum mode and generates an appendix.

say_en.text: Create a PRD including user stories and acceptance criteria.
